fact: The Ministry of Finance and Budget officially launched e-TPU on 17 September 2026, a platform for online filing and electronic payment of the Taxe Professionnelle Unique, including via mobile money (Flooz and Mixx by Yas), with an electronic receipt, available 24/7.
The Office Togolais des Recettes reports electronic payment (telepaiement) of VAT at 100% for the DGE and DME directorates in 2025 and 24% for the DCIG/DOFAN/DOFR directorates.
OTR publishes electronic declaration and payment rates by directorate for 2020 to 2025, with telepaiement at 24% for DCIG/DOFAN/DOFR in 2025, up from 13% in 2024.
